summary: Inspected books/arithmetic-5/lib/basic-ops/common.lisp (1286 lines, 48271 bytes). This is an authored ACL2 library file by Robert Krug, part of the arithmetic-5 library. It contains substantial formal mathematical content: function definitions for arithmetic normalization/simplification (collect-+, collect-*, bubble-down), pattern matching algorithms for addend/factor patterns (both gather-exponents and scatter-exponents variants), value computation functions, info list processing for factor matching, multiple clauses for finding matching factors (with rational/non-zero-rational variants), arithmetic factor pattern functions, and prime factorization utilities including a 1000-prime constant table. It also contains guard verification theorems (defthm inside local/encapsulate), verify-guards events, and include-book forms. This is core authored formal mathematics, not a build artifact or sidecar.
